title: Are GTA 6 Leaks Finally Over? Take-Two's Legal Crusade Continues
description: Examining Take-Two's legal crackdown on GTA 6 leaks, the closure of hubs like CyberLeek, and whether the leaks have truly come to an end.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Ongoing Saga of GTA 6 Leaks

As the gaming community eagerly awaits further official updates regarding Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title, the issue of information security and unauthorized leaks remains a constant battleground. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Eurogamer, Take-Two Interactive's aggressive legal crusade has targeted various hubs behind the leaks.

## The Crackdown on Leak Hubs

Over the development cycle of the game, numerous unofficial platforms have emerged to share unverified details and assets. Prominent among these was the CyberLeek website, which recently went dark following intense legal pressure from the publisher. Take-Two has historically maintained a zero-tolerance policy toward the distribution of leaked material, utilizing swift legal action to shut down platforms that facilitate the spread of such content.

## Have the Leaks Actually Stopped?

Despite the closure of specific distribution points like CyberLeek, the situation remains fluid. An update from Eurogamer on August 22, 2026, at 3:30 PM confirmed that the leaks have not stopped. This demonstrates that while corporate legal measures can successfully take down prominent hosting websites, the decentralized nature of internet communities allows information channels to persist in various forms.

## Editor's Take
While Take-Two's legal actions demonstrate a fierce commitment to protecting their intellectual property, the persistence of these leaks highlights the immense challenge of controlling information in the modern digital age. Players should continue to rely on official channels for verified updates.
